title: Jimmy Bell, violinist at the Grand Theater
summary: Levy recalls Jimmy Bell as a strong violinist at the Grand Theater and says he arranged for Bell's band.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: There's another violinist around about that time, Jimmy Bell.
Jimmy Bell played a very good violin, very strong too. He played the Grand Theater, you know, in the pit there. And then he had a band of his own. I made some arrangements for Jimmy Bell's band too.
No, it was the Grand. Jimmy Bell played the Grand.
I thought he had his own band.
